title: Pagination Loop
prompt: Implement collect(fetch) where fetch(page) returns {'items': [...], 'has_more': bool}. Loop pages from 1, extending items, stopping when has_more is False or page exceeds 1000 (safety bound). Return the concatenated list.

tests.name: collects all pages
tests.code:
data = {1: {'items': [1, 2], 'has_more': True}, 2: {'items': [3], 'has_more': False}}
assert collect(lambda p: data[p]) == [1, 2, 3]

tests.name: safety bound stops runaway servers
tests.code: assert collect(lambda p: {'items': [p], 'has_more': True}) == [p for p in range(1, 1001)]
tests.hint: After 1000 pages, stop even if has_more never turns False.
